description.text:
The third POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments from April to August 2006.

Every card in the packs is non-holo, Ho-Oh ex too. Holo copies came later in shop products: Blastoise in the Crystal Trainer Set, a Toys "R" Us exclusive (September 2006), Minun and Plusle in EX Dragon Frontiers blisters and Flareon, Jolteon and Vaporeon in Eeveelution blisters (both November 2006), and Ho-Oh ex in the 2007 Spring Collector's Tins.

description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy from the Crystal Trainer Set, sold only at Toys "R" Us from September 2006, with an EX Crystal Guardians Theme Deck and three booster packs. It isn't found in POP Series 3 packs, which held only non-holo copies of the set's rares.
